caption: The drawing depicts a shallow, wide, metallic cup with two symmetrical, rounded handles on either side, both featuring a slight decorative curl at their bases. The surface of the cup is smooth and reflective, with an inscription on the front reading “G. H. MDCCXI.” Below and to the left of the cup, there is a small, separate detailed illustration of what appears to be a decorative or ornamental object with a rounded top and circular designs. The entire drawing is rendered in pencil or graphite on a plain, light-colored background, creating a monochromatic composition with subtle shading that gives the objects a three-dimensional appearance. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature and the date "Amelia Lucas - 1936."
title: Silver Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
